newsitem.title: TAIWAN: One killed, 20 injured in Taiwan train accident.
newsitem.headline: One killed, 20 injured in Taiwan train accident.

text.p: A passenger train derailed in northeastern Taiwan on Thursday, killing a truck driver and injuring 20 people, police said.
"The first car of the train derailed while the second burst into fire as it smashed into a cement truck near Wai Ao station in (the town of) Touchen," a police officer told Reuters.
Truck driver Lin Chun-yi, 32, was killed, while 20 of the train's 380 passengers were injured, the officer said.
Preliminary investigations showed the accident occurred because the truck had stopped too close to the railway tracks, the officer said.
